name: url
label: VictoriaTraces URL
help:
The base URL that serves the VictoriaTraces querying API, **without** `/select`.

- Single-node: `http://<host>:10428`
- Cluster (vtselect): `http://<vtselect>:10471`
- Behind vmauth or VictoriaMetrics Cloud: the URL your proxy exposes for trace queries

pattern.message: Enter a URL starting with http:// or https://, without a username or password in it

fields.name: apiToken
fields.label: Bearer token
fields.help: Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>` — for example a vmauth bearer token or a VictoriaMetrics Cloud access token with read access.

name: accountId
label: Account ID
help: Tenant account ID for multitenant VictoriaTraces, sent as the `AccountID` header. Leave empty for the default tenant.

name: projectId
label: Project ID
help: Tenant project ID for multitenant VictoriaTraces, sent as the `ProjectID` header. Leave empty for the default tenant.

name: indexServices
label: Services and dependencies
help: Services (`service.name`) and the calls between them, from the service graph.

name: indexOperations
label: Operations
help: The operations (server and consumer span names) of each service. Leave unticked if your span names include IDs or full URLs, which would create very many objects.

name: indexOtelK8s
label: Kubernetes (OpenTelemetry)
help: Kubernetes clusters, nodes, namespaces, workloads and pods from OpenTelemetry `k8s.*` resource attributes.

name: indexLookback
label: Indexing lookback
help: How far back to look for spans when discovering objects, as a duration such as `30m`, `1h` or `6h`. Objects without spans in this window aren't indexed. Longer windows find more objects but make indexing slower.

pattern.message: Use a duration such as 30m, 1h or 1d

name: defaultCluster
label: Default cluster name
help: Cluster to assume for spans without a `k8s.cluster.name` resource attribute, so Kubernetes objects match those from the VictoriaMetrics and VictoriaLogs plugins and drilldowns resolve.
